duration: Separate optional manual operation; approval waits unknown
summary: Phase 7 is optional. Agents prepare/review files only; human dispatch and independent environment approval are separate. Unverifiable protections fail closed.

steps.title: Confirm existing AKS/ACR and real inputs
do: Require actual namespace/image values, registry/cluster identity, RBAC, kubelet pulls and connected equipped runners.
Do not create resources, fetch tools, invent demo image defaults or enter secrets into HTML.
steps.see: Real prerequisites or explicitly unset inputs; no claim of deployment readiness.

steps.title: Review application manifests only
do: Review non-root Deployments, probes, resource bounds and ClusterIP Services.
Static checks use existing dependencies; no authentication, cloud calls, build/push or namespace creation.
steps.see: Static evidence and missing inputs, not a live cluster validation.

steps.title: Require independently verifiable protections
do: Require independent reviewer, prevent self-review, no admin bypass and exact main-only rules.
Verify the live controls/plan support; unavailable or unverifiable approval gates stop.
steps.see: Fail-closed protection evidence, not an assumption based on YAML.

steps.title: Pin trusted current main and modern CI
steps.where: Reviewed main › Exact current source SHA › CI
do: Use the current full main SHA, not this guide's dated source pin or demo-complete.
Require successful modern-service checks and distinct OIDC registry/deploy identities.
steps.see: Exact-SHA evidence; a push or PR never starts deployment.

steps.title: Only if separately authorized, dispatch manually
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Deploy AKS (manual main only)
do: The human supplies the reviewed current SHA and explicitly confirms this separate action.
Same-run immutable image digests must pass the independent approval gate; dispatch is not approval.
steps.warn: Agents and this HTML never dispatch, authenticate or deploy.
steps.see: An actual approved workflow result or truthful failure/wait; no latest-tag fallback.

steps.title: Inspect status/logs/access within the existing namespace
steps.where: Terminal › Kubernetes status / Kubernetes logs / Kubernetes port-forward
do: Use the existing approved user context, actual namespace and intended sample.
Missing tools/network/approval means stop; do not fetch credentials, grant RBAC or create ingress.
steps.see: Observed namespace-scoped outcomes or a documented NOT RUN.
